summary: Bayfield County National Forest lookout tower in place by 1953; FFLA lists it as gone, and a DNR timber sale is named for it.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association. Central US Lookouts shows an unexplained 'Removed' label under the lookout name. No removal date or cause found in the sources read.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey station description places the lookout tower at the site, with a survey mark 41 feet from its southeast leg.
DNR Good Neighbor Authority timber sale named Lenawee Tower, tract 8001-02-25, 103 acres, contract ending June 30, 2028. Year taken from the PDF file name.

evidence.supports: Bayfield County, National Forest, on the Central US Lookouts page
Tower stood on U.S. Forest Service property at the survey station site

evidence.supports: Survey mark 41 feet from the tower's southeast leg

DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1953 (DAJ)

evidence.supports: Unexplained 'Removed' label under the lookout name, with no date or explanation
The sale property is the Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest

sources.title: Good Neighbor Authority: Lenawee Tower, tract 8001-02-25

notes_for_editor: The only evidence that the tower existed (1953) is the NGS station description reproduced on Central US Lookouts (datasheet PID RM0803). No construction date found. The page's 'Removed' label is not explained there and may refer to the survey mark rather than the tower; worth checking the NGS datasheet directly. The 2025 year for the DNR sale comes from the PDF file name. Access and visit fields not established.
